idea-plugin.name: Integrated AI Workbench
idea-plugin.description:
Integrated AI Workbench is a local-first AI development environment integrated into IntelliJ IDEA.
The project aims to support user-supplied local language models, agent and skill workflows, controlled project grounding, secure tool execution, structured output, and model evaluation.
The Base Plugin is under active development. Cloud services and external AI applications are not required by its intended core architecture.
